# SoftDesk

> AI-powered desktop software management & smart launcher for macOS and Windows.
> Open source, free, cross-platform.

Last Updated: 2026-08-06

## Product Summary

SoftDesk is a desktop application that helps you manage and launch software efficiently.
It scans installed applications, uses AI to automatically classify them, provides a radial
menu for quick launching via mouse middle-click, tracks usage time per app, and supports
one-click workflows to launch multiple apps together.

## Key Features

- [AI Smart Classification](/features/ai-classification) / [中文](/zh/features/ai-classification) - Automatically categorize apps using AI models
- [Radial Menu Launcher](/features/radial-menu) / [中文](/zh/features/radial-menu) - Middle-click to summon radial menu for instant app launch
- [Usage Time Tracking](/features/usage-tracking) / [中文](/zh/features/usage-tracking) - Track per-app usage time and productivity insights
- [Cross-Platform](/features/cross-platform) / [中文](/zh/features/cross-platform) - Support for macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What is SoftDesk? An AI-powered desktop software manager for macOS and Windows, offering smart classification, radial menu quick-launch, usage tracking, and workflow automation.
- Which platforms does SoftDesk support? macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11.
- How does SoftDesk protect privacy? It runs entirely locally with data in a local SQLite database; no personal data is uploaded. Cloud sync via Supabase is optional and encrypted.
- Is SoftDesk free? Yes, it is open-source and completely free.

## Technical Details

- Desktop Framework: Electron 31 + React 18 + TypeScript
- Local Database: better-sqlite3
- Cloud Sync: Supabase (optional)
- AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other configurable providers
- License: Open Source
